background: OCBC is Singapore's second-largest bank, funded by Singapore dollar deposits and lending across Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia and Greater China, with Great Eastern as its insurance arm and Bank of Singapore in private banking.
synthesis: Ratings are among the highest in Asia: AA- from Fitch and S&P and Aa1 from Moody's, all stable. Capital is strong against Asian peers, with CET1 of 15.7% at the median and leverage of 6.5% in the top quarter, though both have come down since 30 Jun 2025, CET1 by 1.3 points and leverage by 0.8 points. Liquidity is the weak side, with LCR of 131% and NSFR of 109% both in the bottom quarter against the peer medians. The flagged news is good, with record first-half profit on 7 Aug 2026. Well rated and well capitalised, with liquidity ratios that sit lower than most Asian peers.
